title: CISA added Apple WebKit CVE-2024-27834 to KEV on Nov 4 based on exploitation evidence. The pointer-authentication bypass requires prior arbi
content_md:
CISA added Apple WebKit CVE-2024-27834 to KEV on Nov 4 based on exploitation evidence. The pointer-authentication bypass requires prior arbi
